Then King Ahasuerus said to Esther the queen and to Mordecai the Jew, “See, I have given Esther the house of Haman, and…
I will cut off all the horns of the wicked, but the horns of the righteous shall be lifted up.
The king’s heart is in Yahweh’s hand like the watercourses. He turns it wherever he desires.

people.name: Cush
people.line: Ancient region in Africa; associated with Egypt and Babylon

people.name: Ebed-melech
people.line: Ethiopian eunuch who rescued Jeremiah from a cistern

people.name: Jeremiah
people.line: Son of Hilkiah, the prophet during Judah's final days.

translations.web: Then the king commanded Ebedmelech the Ethiopian, saying, “Take from here thirty men with you, and take up Jeremiah the prophet out of the dungeon, before he dies.”
translations.bsb: So the king commanded Ebed-melech the Cushite, “Take thirty men from here with you and pull Jeremiah the prophet out of the cistern before he dies.”
translations.kjv: Then the king commanded Ebedmelech the Ethiopian, saying, Take from hence thirty men with thee, and take up Jeremiah the prophet out of the dungeon, before he die.
translations.asv: Then the king commanded Ebed-melech the Ethiopian, saying, Take from hence thirty men with thee, and take up Jeremiah the prophet out of the dungeon, before he die.
